title: Joining a road show in Birmingham (TOBA-type circuit)
summary: Explains 'road shows' as touring revues of musicians and entertainers, which he picked up in Birmingham.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Then I got to this...you call it... Well, you call it, TOBA is the road... We called them road shows. I got this show down there in Birmingham, Alabama -- this road show.
What was the name of the road show?
The road show was... It doesn't have to be no name. We called them road show because they were on the road all the time..
I see. So they were like traveling revues...
...of just... A group of entertainers and actors and musicians, and there would be various ones leaving, and others replacing them, and that sort of thing.
